_help: Act 9, Level 1, the surface ruins: the dead hold the way to the stairs. What you learned on the surface in Act 4 gets you past (end_safe + a flag act9.gd uses); otherwise fight (event act9_surface_fight, end_fight). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act89.py.

start.speaker: noura
start.line: They are everywhere between us and the stair. Unless you know another way.

choices.label: Speak the greeting
choices.line: The words from the Hall of Greetings. 'Open, ways, for one who comes home.'

choices.label: Take the obelisk passage
choices.line: The broken obelisk points to a cut through the rubble. That way.

choices.label: Raise Anubis's sign
choices.line: The jackal sign from the statue. Hold it up where they can see.

choices.label: Fight through
choices.line: Then we go straight through them.

o_0.speaker: noura
o_0.line: ...They stand aside. They stand aside! Those are the old words. Walk, quickly.

o_1.speaker: noura
o_1.line: A path around them. Good. Quietly.

o_2.speaker: noura
o_2.line: They falter. They will not come near the sign. Keep it high.

fight.speaker: omar
fight.line: Then fight, and keep her alive!
